description: windfarmGA is an R package for wind-turbine placement optimisation maintained by Sebastian Gatscha and collaborators. It searches candidate grid-cell layouts with a genetic algorithm and can account for wind roses, turbine choices, land boundaries, terrain and roughness. Users supply a site polygon, candidate turbines, wind and terrain data, spacing rules and an objective; outputs are candidate layouts and estimated energy or fitness values. Geographic coverage is a user-defined wind farm, and the modelled horizon follows the wind-resource inputs. The R package DESCRIPTION declares MIT terms, with a copyright file in the repository, and the README gives an end-to-end example. A limitation is that an optimised layout under simplified wind and terrain assumptions still needs engineering, permitting and ecological checks. windfarmGA can compare generation-infrastructure siting options. The catalogue's model-pypsa treats electricity networks at a different scale. No wind raster or package was downloaded.
inputs: Site polygon, wind resource and terrain
name: windfarmGA wind-farm layout optimiser
